subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should Mattermost cold-thread recovery use this one timeout-bounded synchronous fetch per stored session, with no retry after failure until the session rotates?
rationale: Both retrying and not retrying have user-visible tradeoffs: retries can repeatedly delay inbound turns during an outage, while no retry leaves the recovered session without prior thread context after a transient failure.

options.title: Accept bounded cold-turn recovery
options.body: Approve one timeout-bounded fetch per stored session and accept that a failed attempt waits for the next session rotation before retrying.

options.title: Revise the failure policy
options.body: Require a narrowly bounded retry or background recovery design with focused live latency and transient-failure proof before merge.

options.title: Decline synchronous recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and leave the canonical issue open for an alternative that never waits on Mattermost REST during inbound handling.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded cold-turn recovery
recommendation.body: Approve one timeout-bounded fetch per stored session and accept that a failed attempt waits for the next session rotation before retrying.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository assigns Mattermost ownership to this maintainer, so they are best positioned to accept the channel-specific latency and recovery semantics.
